summary: Jay Yambert, 56, of Champaign, Illinois, got lost while descending from Longs Peak on Sunday and spent an unexpected night on the mountain in severe weather; family contacted the park Monday morning; the NPS SAR team deployed at 8:45 a.m. Monday and aerial searchers located him below Peacock Pool in the Roaring Fork drainage around 4 p.m.; rangers reached him on foot, gave food and water; he declined a helicopter ride and medical evaluation and hiked out with ranger assistance
location: Longs Peak (Peacock Pool / Roaring Fork drainage)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR team
notes: Incident date 2014-07-27 = Sunday (weekday-verified), found Monday 2014-07-28 (weekday-verified); corroborated by the Gazette 2014-07-29 "Body on Longs Peak ID'd; hiker found" account.
